_meta.description: Expected Robinhood Chain mainnet V4 deployment used by T024 as the baseline for the capability probe. The chain_id, PoolManager, and StateView values come from public documentation; the bytecode hashes are left empty until the on-chain probe is run against a real endpoint and the report is committed.
_meta.license: Documentation references are public; deployment addresses are public facts on the respective chains.

_verification_notes: Run probe_chain_capability(adapter, ExpectedDeployment(...)) and commit the resulting ChainCapabilityReport under docs/implement/protocol-artifacts/chain-capability-report-robinhood-mainnet.json.
Populate pool_manager_code_hash and state_view_code_hash from the report's pool_manager.<endpoint>.code_hash and state_view.<endpoint>.code_hash fields.
All endpoints must agree on chain_id, PoolManager bytecode hash, and StateView bytecode hash before this artifact can be marked 'verified'.
If any endpoint reports a different chain_id or bytecode hash, the report fails and the deployment is rejected (T024 acceptance).
